commit message:
Ihw fdr control (#22)

* added ihw-script for testing

* IHW-integration in workflow

* created an own environment for ihw, refactoring variables in ihw-script, changing some references to wildcards in reports

* changes according to View #22, in ihw-fdr-control.R script added merging of ens_gene and ext_gene columns in ihw-results .tsv-files

* Add `--conda-cleanup-pkgs` to GitHub Action args.

This is an attempt to keep the space needed by the conda environments as small as possible.

* Add `--latency-wait 15` seconds to GitHub Actions.

Attempt to avoid error of the CI Test.

* View #22: changes in merging of ens_gene and ext_gene columns in ihw-results .tsv-files and NA-handling

* View #22: ihw merging of columns as pipe

* remove debugging code

* add feature request link to IHW TODO

* add `ls` to debug GitHub Actions missing output failure

* more debugging output

* a little less verbosity from conda

* force conda in bioc download to copy, less verbose

* bioc db download: remove `--quiet`

* more bioc db download debugging output

* try bioc db download with `conda clean` before and after

* remove `--latency-wait 15` from GitHub Action

* try cleaning up Docker container

* force docker system prune in GitHub Actions

otherwise, it prompts to ask if we're sure and defaults to No

* GitHub Actions: try cleaning up Docker container earlier

* bioc db download less verbose, find where space is used in Docker container

* fix

* fix `du -sh` calls

* biomaRt: iterate through mirrors upon error

With the current configuration, it will iterate through the whole set of mirrors three times and then finally give up. At the end of each round, the script will wait for 30 seconds in the hope that intermittent errors go away. And the script explicitly does not start with the default mirror "www", as this is the one with very frequent errors.

* bioc db download: remove all debugging output

* GitHub Action: remove `docker system prune` as it has no effect

* Instruct snakemake action to cleanup conda cache as well.

* Remove explicit conda clean again.

* sleuth-init.R: revert to species-specific biomart dataset selection
